Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities and compound_structures. Join activities to compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter by assay CHEMBL1613918, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
